entities.name: Irini Sengir
entities.description: Vampire adopted daughter of Baron Sengir, once a dwarven princess of New Freedom, and a talented enchantress.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire lord who turned Irini into a vampire and adopted her.

entities.name: New Freedom
entities.description: Dwarven kingdom on Ulgrotha where Irini was born.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane where Irini's story takes place.

entities.name: Reveka
entities.description: Great-granddaughter of Irini, unaware of the relation.

entities.name: Ihsan's Shade
entities.description: Spirit controlled by Sengir's signet ring, which Irini covets.

events.summary: Baron Sengir begins a campaign against the dwarves, turns Irini into a vampire and adopts her as his daughter.
events.quote: When the Baron Sengir began his campaign against the dwarves, he turned Irini into a vampire and adopted her as his daughter.

relations.quote: Irini Sengir is the "adopted daughter" of Baron Sengir .

relations.note: Great-grandmother, though Reveka does not know it.
Completely loyal after a mind spell.
relations.quote: Irini became completely loyal to the Baron after he cast a spell on her mind.
